definition: Having a shape resembling a convex lens.
book: Twenty Thousand Leagues under the Sea
author: Jules Verne
quote: The power of the lantern seemed increased a hundredfold, like a lamp through the lenticular plates of a first-class lighthouse.
example_sentence: Lenticular clouds hovered over the mountain like flying saucers.
